items.title: APT Hackers Use NetamLoader Malware to Target Windows 10 Systems in Asian Governments
items.description:

The campaign looks like a supply-chain operation, and nobody has linked it to a known hacking group yet. The malware hides inside a Windows update package, borrows trusted software to run, and […]
